dct_description_sm:
The 2025 Canadian Election Study (CES) was conducted to document the attitudes of Canadians during and after the 2025 election. It continues the tradition of Canadian Election Studies started in 1965.

Content Advisory: Some datasets available through Odesi, including those containing open-ended survey responses, may include language or perspectives that users may find offensive, harmful, or outdated. This content reflects the social, cultural, and historical context in which the data were collected and is preserved in its original, unaltered form to maintain the integrity and research value of the record. While efforts are made to use respectful and inclusive language in accompanying metadata and documentation, the underlying data may not reflect current standards.
